This reverts commit b0defa7ae03ecf91b8bfd10ede430cff12fcbd06.
b0defa7ae03ec changed the load balancing logic to ignore env.max_loop if
all tasks examined to that point were pinned. The goal of the patch was
to make it more likely to be able to detach a task buried in a long list
of pinned tasks. However
column2: this has the unfortunate side effect of

column1: creating an O(n) iteration in detach_tasks()
iterate every task on a cpu if all or most are pinned. Since this load
balance code is done with rq lock held
is very easy to trigger hard lockups. We observed such hard lockups with
a user who affined O(10k) threads to a single cpu.
When I discussed this with Vincent he initially suggested that we keep
the limit on the number of tasks to detach
tasks we can search. However
column2: after some back and forth on the mailing

column1: list
column2: he recommended we instead revert the original patch

column1: likely no one was actually getting hit by the original issue.
